_comment: Delta patch for knowledge/graph/agentic_universe_graph.json. Generic node/edge shape — adapt to agentic_universe_schema.json and validate with tools/knowledge_graph.py before applying. Dedupe proj-hermes-agent if earlier patches were applied.

nodes.label: A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol
nodes.summary: Open standard for agent‑to‑agent communication: signed Agent Cards, multi‑tenancy, three bindings; joined Agentic AI Foundation (Aug 2026). Horizontal layer for task negotiation/delegation across org boundaries.

nodes.label: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
nodes.summary: Vertical layer for agent→tools/data access; 2026‑07‑28 spec made core stateless; hosted under Agentic AI Foundation alongside A2A.

nodes.label: Google ADK (Agent Development Kit)
nodes.summary: Code‑first Python framework for building/evaluating/deploying agents; ADK 2.0 ships Agent Skills with progressive disclosure and a structured Task API for agent‑to‑agent delegation.

nodes.label: Human‑in‑the‑loop approval gates
nodes.summary: Place gates on irreversible/high‑blast‑radius actions; log who approved what and why; audit gates quarterly and remove zero‑catch gates over 90 days. Required by AEGIS/CSA guidance; verify enforcement (gates often don't actually stop).

summary.label: Progressive skill/tool disclosure
summary.summary: List/load/run skill model; inject 3–5 skills/tools per step; log injected schemas; measure retrieval precision as catalogs grow. Mitigates SkillBloat token‑amplification attacks.

summary.label: Compaction as a first‑class primitive
summary.summary: Compact to schema (JSON) not prose; validate state on transitions; enable compaction in harness history pipelines; measure long‑horizon reward, not just task success.

summary.label: OpenAI Assistants API sunset (2026‑08‑26)
summary.summary: Assistants API removed; replacement is Responses + Conversations APIs. Agent Builder/Evals close Nov 30, 2026. Migration targets are themselves deprecated in some docs — plan exit carefully.

summary.label: Azure Assistants API retired (2026‑08‑26)
summary.summary: Azure OpenAI Assistants retired same day; migration target is Microsoft Foundry Agents (classic retires Mar 31, 2027).

summary.label: Long‑Horizon Terminal‑Bench (LHTB)
summary.summary: 46 tasks over hundreds of steps with 90‑minute budgets; measures sustained useful work in a containerized terminal. Frontier models show meaningful gaps.
